Please, add a module doc-string (`/-! ... -/`) before `open MvPolynomial`.

Hint: Type `m(odule docstring) + [tab]` to insert a template via snippet.

Note: This linter can be disabled with `set_option linter.style.header false`

@hasseDeriv : {σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R

def MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv.{u_1, u_2} : {σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
fun {σ} {R} [CommSemiring R] d ↦
  ((Finsupp.lsum R) fun k ↦ monomial (k - d) ∘ₗ (LinearMap.lsmul R R) ↑(hasseCoeff d k)) ∘ₗ
    ↑(AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv R)
'MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
AddMonoidAlgebra.instModule
fun d ↦ ⇑(hasseDeriv d) : (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R → MvPolynomial σ R
fun d ↦ hasseDeriv d : (ℕ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial ℕ ℕ →ₗ[ℕ] MvPolynomial ℕ ℕ

fun d ↦
  hasseDeriv
    d : (ULift.{1, 0} ℕ →₀ ℕ) →
  MvPolynomial (ULift.{1, 0} ℕ) (ULift.{1, 0} ℕ) →ₗ[ULift.{1, 0} ℕ] MvPolynomial (ULift.{1, 0} ℕ) (ULift.{1, 0} ℕ)

@hasseDeriv_monomial : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (d k : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R),
  (hasseDeriv d) ((monomial k) a) = (monomial (k - d)) (↑(hasseCoeff d k) * a)

@hasseCoeff_eq_zero_iff : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (d k : σ →₀ ℕ), hasseCoeff d k = 0 ↔ ¬d ≤ k
'MvPolynomial.hasseCoeff_eq_zero_iff' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

@coeff_hasseDeriv : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (d e : σ →₀ ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ((hasseDeriv d) P).coeff e = ↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d)) * P.coeff (e + d)
'MvPolynomial.coeff_hasseDeriv' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

theorem MvPolynomial.coeff_hasseDeriv.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  (d e : σ →₀ ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R), ((hasseDeriv d) P).coeff e = ↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d)) * P.coeff (e + d) :=
fun {σ} {R} [CommSemiring R] d e P ↦
  induction_on' P
    (fun k a ↦
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a.coeff e = ↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d)) * ((monomial k) a).coeff (e + d))
            (hasseDeriv_monomial d k a)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = ↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d)) * ((monomial k) a).coeff (e + d))
              (coeff_monomial e (k - d) (↑(hasseCoeff d k) * a))))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (if k - d = e then ↑(hasseCoeff d k) * a else 0) = ↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d)) * _a)
                (coeff_monomial (e + d) k a)))
            (if hk : k = e + d then
              of_eq_true
                (Eq.trans
                  (congr
                    (congrArg Eq
                      (Eq.trans
                        (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true (↑(hasseCoeff d k) * a) 0
                          (Eq.trans
                            (congrFun'
                              (congrArg Eq (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg HSub.hSub hk) d) (add_tsub_cancel_right e d)))
                              e)
                            (eq_self e)))
                        (congrFun' (congrArg HMul.hMul (congrArg Nat.cast (congrArg (hasseCoeff d) hk))) a)))
                    (congrArg (HMul.hMul ↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d)))
                      (ite_eq_left_of_eq_true a 0 (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq hk) (e + d)) (eq_self (e + d))))))
                  (eq_self (↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d)) * a)))
            else
              if hdk : d ≤ k then
                of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congr
                      (congrArg Eq
                        (ite_eq_right_of_eq_false (↑(hasseCoeff d k) * a) 0
                          (Eq.trans ((fun x_0 ↦ propext ((fun x_0 ↦ tsub_eq_iff_eq_add_of_le hdk) x_0)) e)
                            (eq_false hk))))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg (HMul.hMul ↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d))) (ite_eq_right_of_eq_false a 0 (eq_false hk)))
                        (mul_zero ↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d)))))
                    (eq_self 0))
              else
                of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congr
                      (congrArg Eq
                        (Eq.trans
                          (ite_congr (Eq.refl (k - d = e))
                            (fun a_1 ↦
                              Eq.trans
                                (congrFun'
                                  (congrArg HMul.hMul
                                    (Eq.trans (congrArg Nat.cast ((hasseCoeff_eq_zero_iff d k).mpr hdk)) Nat.cast_zero))
                                  a)
                                (zero_mul a))
                            fun a ↦ Eq.refl 0)
                          (ite_self 0)))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (congrArg (HMul.hMul ↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d))) (ite_eq_right_of_eq_false a 0 (eq_false hk)))
                        (mul_zero ↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d)))))
                    (eq_self 0))))))
    fun p q hp hq ↦
    of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congr
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun' (congrArg DFunLike.coe (congrArg AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff (map_add (hasseDeriv d) p q))) e)
              (congr (congrArg HAdd.hAdd hp) hq)))
          (mul_add (↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d))) (p.coeff (e + d)) (q.coeff (e + d))))
        (eq_self (↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d)) * p.coeff (e + d) + ↑(hasseCoeff d (e + d)) * q.coeff (e + d))))
@hasseCoeff_eq_prod : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] (d k : σ →₀ ℕ), hasseCoeff d k = ∏ j, (k j).choose (d j)
'MvPolynomial.hasseCoeff_eq_prod' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
